summary: This is a clipped Halo Waypoint web page for Halo Infinite, mostly navigation and platform boilerplate. The actual promotional text says Cyber Showdown returns with a free 20-tier Operation Pass with new customization rewards for the CHIMERA Armor Core, and the Premium Operation Pass adds the Emberbreak Armor Coating, a fourth Challenge Slot, and bonus XP. The page lists Xbox, Windows and Steam as platforms. The note's domain field says earth_science, but its content is about a video game.
one_line: Halo Waypoint promotion for Halo Infinite's Cyber Showdown event, its free and Premium Operation Passes, and platform availability.
key_facts: The page's main heading is "Halo Infinite".
The promotional text opens with "Arise, Executor!" and says Cyber Showdown returns.
Cyber Showdown returns with a free 20-tier Operation Pass.
The free Operation Pass features new customization rewards for the CHIMERA Armor Core.
Securing the Premium Operation Pass obtains the Emberbreak Armor Coating.
The Premium Operation Pass also grants a fourth Challenge Slot and bonus XP.
The page lists availability on Xbox, Windows and Steam.
The site's Games menu links to Halo Infinite and Halo: The Master Chief Collection.
The site's Community menu links to Halo Insider, Content Browser and Leaderboards.
The site's navigation includes News, Esports, Show, Support and Gear sections.
The page includes a "Get Halo" purchase button.
The note's metadata lists the domain as "earth_science" and the source as "bright", which does not match the video game content.
